$comment: Maintainer-only tool: pushes en.json source-string changes up to the Localazy project for translators (`npx @localazy/cli upload`). This is NOT the runtime/production sync path — the running app never invokes the Localazy CLI. `download` here exists for a maintainer to preview translations locally; it is not wired into any boot or scheduled task. The actual runtime sync is backend/tasks/simple/update-locales.ts, which pulls directly from requarks/wiki-locales (a live, Wiki.js-3.x-specific mirror of this Localazy project, refreshed hourly) on a daily cron with no Localazy account required. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full rationale.
